title: LogicPilot platform contracts - shared definitions
description: Shared identifier, version and provenance definitions reused by every platform contract. Definitions are globally unique across the schemas/contracts/ directory; the generators resolve cross-file $refs by definition name.

CapabilityId.description: Stable capability identifier contributed or required by a plugin (dotted, lowercase).

VersionRange.description: Version range expression (npm-style) resolved against SemanticVersion.

Sha256Hex.description: Lowercase or uppercase SHA-256 hex digest for content addressing.

LocalizedKey.description: Localization message key; natural language text is never the semantic carrier.

Actor.description: Who produced a revision or transaction: a human user, the agent, or a plugin id.

Provenance.description: Where a piece of content came from and how much it can be trusted.

locator.description: Page, figure, equation or section locator inside the source.

JsonSchemaFragment.description: Free-form JSON Schema fragment (parameter schemas, config schemas). Treated as opaque structured data by the platform.

JsonValue.description: Any JSON value. Used for type-specific structured payloads the core does not interpret.
